expected_behavior: A new REAL CLI run with a modified netlist must create a fresh result and must not accept the copied historical report as the current run.
Explicit replay with a forged expected netlist hash must be rejected.
Normal replay using a tampered run_id must be rejected as historical/stale input.
A broken ngspice run executed in a folder containing an old successful result must stay in ERROR and must not load the historical success.
Explicit replay of an artifact declared as coming from another commit must be rejected.
